definitions.explanation: polite term for customer, patron, or guest; the standard respectful term used by businesses and service providers to address or refer to customers

examples.japanese: お{客様|きゃくさま}、ご⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よろしい→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Customer, is that all for your order?

examples.japanese: お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にして⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧です。
examples.english: The customer is god. (Customer is always right.)

notes:
HONORIFIC TERM:
お{客様|きゃくさま} is the standard honorific term for customers in business contexts. It combines the honorific prefix お～ with ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ (guest/customer) and the honorific suffix ～⟦{様|さま}→様：01549_sama⟧.

FORMALITY LEVELS:
- お{客様|きゃくさま} - most polite (business standard)
- ⟦お{客|きゃく}さん→お客さん：10253_okyakusan⟧ - polite (casual business)
- ⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧ - neutral/plain

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦{各位|かくい}→各位：12042_kakui⟧ - dear customers (written)
- お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ - customer service
- お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ - customer feedback/voice
- お{客様|きゃくさま}センター - customer center

CULTURAL NOTE:
「お{客様|きゃくさま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧です」(The customer is god) is a famous Japanese saying reflecting the emphasis on customer service.
